author: Katharine Shaw
text:
Blood sugar can rise in the morning as the liver releases glucose in anticipation of you getting up and doing stuff like getting dressed, having a wash, going downstairs etc.  

It usually drops fairly quickly as I think the liver releases glucose-absorbs some of the glucose if it isn’t used. 

So the answer to you question, I think, is take it from the 90 you get when you’ve got up, dressed, washed, etc and before you have breakfast.
